label: JV-880 ROMs
description: JV-880 needs the five files of your own JV-880 (firmware v1.0.0). The plugin loads them by name.
hint: Four files are told apart only by name, so keep the names jv880_rom1.bin, jv880_nvram.bin, jv880_waverom1.bin and jv880_waverom2.bin. The 256 KB rom2 file may have any name: it is saved as jv880_rom2.bin. A v1.0.1 dump does not run.

label: Expansion cards (optional)
description: SR-JV80 expansion card images. Add as many as you like; each one appears as banks in the BANKS browser.
hint: The file name must contain SR-JV80, for example SR-JV80-01_Pop.bin.
